# Bundled QR generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified `qrcode-generator@1.4.4` npm package file from
https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator (Kazuhiko Arase, MIT).
SHA-256: `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`.
The license is included in `qrcode.LICENSE`. The generator runs locally; QR contents are never
sent to an external image-generation service.
